notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying at most {3}, creating a token copy of Mana Vault.
Activate the Mana Vault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
If Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana and you can then target any other artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler.
